-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #1000 / Scene #10 - Function talkevent7_1
function talkevent7_1()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town000D.map")
	MoveCamera(369.00, 340.00, 83.34)
	RotCamera(0.01, 1.47, 12.00)

	CreateObject(0, 1481, 365.00, 345.00, 30, 0, FALSE, 1, 28)
	CreateObject(1, 1036, 371.00, 339.00, 150, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(2, 1480, 362.00, 327.00, 90, 0, FALSE, 1, 19)
	CreateObject(3, 1478, 366.00, 320.00, 120, 0, FALSE, 1, 1)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayMusic("BGM031.ogg")
	FaceObject(0, 18, 0)
	PlayCameraNoWait("tutorial_01_10.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	wait(500)
	OpenTalkScene(3, 10)
	WalkObject(1, 508.000000, 379.000000, 96.089996, 1, 4, 1)
	wait(1000)
	WarpObject(1, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1, 0, 0)
	wait(1500)
	PlayCameraNoWait("tutorial_01_11b.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	WalkObject(2, 371.000000, 339.000000, 83.339996, 1, 4, 3)
	wait(1500)
	RotateObject(2, 158, 1)
	wait(1500)
	OpenTalkScene(3, 11)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(talkevent7_1)
